title: Partner Portal 1.4.0
summary: Buy and renew plans with Mercado Pago, plan codes NW-50, NW-250 and NW-1000, renewal by resellers and alert e-mails in Portuguese and Spanish.

items.title: Buy plans on the Licences page
items.body: Tick the firewalls, click a plan and pay with Mercado Pago. Plans are per firewall for 6 or 12 months, prices are shown before you pay, and the plan is applied to the firewall when the payment is confirmed.

items.title: Plan codes
items.body: The plans are NW-50, NW-250 and NW-1000, the same in every language. The Licences table has a Plan column next to the Licence status.

items.title: Receipt and invoice
items.body: The buyer receives a receipt by e-mail and Nexwall receives the request to issue the invoice (nota fiscal).

items.title: Renewal by resellers
items.body: A distributor that owns a customer's licence can allow chosen resellers to buy and pay its renewals. Resellers see Managed by distributor or Renewal allowed on the firewall.

items.title: Refunds revoke the plan
items.body: When a payment is refunded the plan bought with it is revoked and the order shows Refunded. A partial refund or a different amount is flagged for review.

items.title: Rules for upgrades and several firewalls
items.body: The same plan extends the licence, a bigger plan starts when the current term ends and a smaller plan is refused. With several firewalls selected only the plans allowed for all of them are enabled.

items.title: Firewall checks in after a purchase
items.body: The portal asks the firewall to check in with the licence server as soon as the plan is applied, so Licence turns Active without waiting for the next scheduled check-in.

items.title: Licence and Plan explained
items.body: The Licences page now says that Licence is what the firewall reports and Plan is what the licence server assigned.

items.title: Alert e-mails in Portuguese and Spanish
items.body: Alert e-mails and Telegram messages exist in Portuguese and Spanish, and each e-mail recipient has its own language.

items.title: Portuguese is the default e-mail language
items.body: Welcome, resend, CSV import and alert e-mails default to Portuguese. The language of the user's company is used when it is set.

items.title: Nexwall brand only
items.body: E-mails and screens carry only the Nexwall name, logo and contacts.
